title: A finite-free top-cohomology approximation lowers the bound in localization descent
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M^\bullet$ a complex of $A$-modules, and $f_1,\ldots,f_r$ generate the unit ideal. View complexes in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix integers $m\le n$. Suppose $H^j(M^\bullet)=0$ for $j>n$, and every termwise localization $M^\bullet\otimes_A A_{f_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] is $m$-pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-m-pseudo-coherent]. There exist complexes $E^\bullet,N^\bullet$ and a distinguished triangle $E^\bullet\to M^\bullet\to N^\bullet\to E^\bullet[1]$ such that $E^\bullet$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent, $H^j(N^\bullet)=0$ for $j>n-1$, and every $N^\bullet\otimes_A A_{f_i}$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent.

source.place: Tag 066D, proof, second and third paragraphs; Tags 064S, 00EO (2), 064R

proof.text: For $n\ge m$, the same bounded finite-free witness proves local $n$-pseudo-coherence: if $n>m$ its degree-$n$ map is an isomorphism and thus an epimorphism. Exact localization transfers global vanishing above $n$ to each localization.
Apply the finite-top-cohomology lemma over each $A_{f_i}$ at degree $n$, and the finite-generation descent lemma to $H^n(M^\bullet)$, obtaining global finite generation.

Choose a finite free module surjecting onto $H^n(M^\bullet)$, lift its basis to cycles, place it in degree $n$, and let $N^\bullet$ be the concrete mapping cone. Applying the derived localization functor gives the cone distinguished triangle; its long exact cohomology sequence shows vanishing in every degree $j>n-1$.

The identity witnesses all fixed-degree pseudo-coherence conditions for the single-term finite-free source, globally and locally. Exact localization commutes with the mapping cone triangle. Apply the first clause of the pseudo-coherence triangle lemma locally to conclude that each localized cone is $m$-pseudo-coherent.

theorem isMPseudoCoherent_localization_cone_step
    {A : Type u₁} [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A)]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ)
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [∀ i : Fin r, HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} (Localization.Away (f i)))]
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (m n : ℤ) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (hvan : ∀ j : ℤ, n < j →
      IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) j).obj (Q.obj M)))
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin r, IsMPseudoCoherent m
        (Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i))))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))) :
    ∃ (E N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ)
      (a : Q.obj E ⟶ Q.obj M) (b : Q.obj M ⟶ Q.obj N)
      (c : Q.obj N ⟶ (Q.obj E)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A)) ∧
      IsMPseudoCoherent m (Q.obj E) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, n - 1 < j →
        IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) j).obj (Q.obj N))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin r, IsMPseudoCoherent m
        (Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i))))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)))
